days.check_in_prompt: Not the safe version — the real one. What do you genuinely want to create or achieve? Write it in vivid detail. Don't hold back.
Between where you are and your vision, what are the three biggest stepping stones? Name them. This turns a dream into a roadmap.
What is the single most important action you can take toward your vision this week? Put it in your calendar right now. When will you do it?
